reason: Full-text proof plan: The residue signs give τ=ζ+ζ⁴−ζ²−ζ³=1+2t with t=ζ+ζ⁴=2cos(2π/5)>0. From Φ_5(ζ)=0 derive t²+t−1=0, so t=(√5−1)/2 and τ=√5. The action lemma makes σ_b fix nonzero τ exactly when (b/5)=1, i.e. b=1,4. Sources inspected: Jerry Shurman, Math 361 Ninth Lecture, §§2–3; J. S. Milne, Algebraic Number Theory, Ch. 6 and Ch. 8 Examples 8.18–8.19. Exact dependency IDs and hypotheses examined for the stated finite argument.
